title: Society for Psychical Research and the history of psychical studies

tellings.quote: Studies have been going on since the 1870s the Society of psychical research

plain: Scientific studies of psychic powers such as telepathy have been going on since the 1870s, starting with the Society for Psychical Research, a group set up to test such claims, and figures like the writer Frederick Myers and the psychologist William James. A documentary maker named Ky Dickens says this to show that her own work on telepathy has a long history behind it. She names no particular source.
